newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end up after choppy day.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end up after choppy day.

text.p: July 10 - U.S. stock index futures finished higher after a choppy session. Traders said market indecisive heading into Friday's PPI. Overall PPI forecast unchanged, core rate up 0.1 pct. Sept S&P 500 traded both sides of Wednesday's closing level. Volume moderate, Sept posts inside day on bar charts.
